title: Complete Global Embeddedness Obstruction for the Reciprocal-Reflection Kato-Muroya Genus-One Four-Catenoidal-End Locus
decided_scope: Complete nonexistence of globally embedded minimal surfaces across all nine puncture distributions N_1+N_2+2N_3=4, all moduli r > 1, and both signed half-periods in the normalized nonzero-spin reciprocal-reflection Kato-Muroya genus-one four-end locus
